card.name: Linking words in food and diet talk
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, them, these, other) right after or within phrases about eating foods, such as raw food, vegetables, soy products or grapefruit. A few fire on digits inside dose numbers.

modes.label: Diet and food phrases
modes.description: Linking words or the word foods inside sentences about eating fruits, vegetables or soy.

modes.label: Digits in dose numbers
modes.description: Part of a number or unit in a dose, where a food word may come next.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward food, fresh and food words in several languages.
card.plain: It notices when a sentence is about eating foods and expects a food word to come next.
